play-2048.description: Slide and merge tiles to reach 2048.

game.title: Minesweeper
game.hint: Click to flag · Hold to uncover · Drag to explore
game.instructions: Click a covered square to place or remove a flag. Hold it to uncover it. Hold a number to uncover every unflagged neighbor — missed mines end the game. Drag or scroll to explore in any direction.
game.keyboard: Keyboard: arrow keys move between squares, F toggles a flag, and Space or Enter uncovers a square or opens the neighbors of a number.

sudoku.hint: Select a square, then enter a number
sudoku.notesOn: Notes on · enter a number to pencil it in
